children: Amplify Commodity Trust reported full-year net income of $79.19M for the year ended June 30, 2026, a swing from a net loss of $(17.50M) in the prior year driven by large net realized futures gains across its funds.
Net income: $79.19M for year ended June 30, 2026 (combined Funds), vs. $(17.50M) for year ended June 30, 2025.
Net income — BDRY: $40.39M for year ended June 30, 2026, vs. $(16.47M) for year ended June 30, 2025.
Net income — BWET: $38.80M for year ended June 30, 2026, vs. $(1.03M) for year ended June 30, 2025.
Revenue & NAV performance: FY26 NAV gains were strong, with BDRY up 115% and BWET up 1,321%, driven by large net realized futures gains.
Market channel shift: Trading was driven by freight futures exposure; creation/redemption activity and intraday futures execution affected tracking between NAV and market price.
Brand & product momentum: BWET was launched in May 2023; both ETFs are actively traded on NYSE Arca with close NAV/market tracking.
Operational risk & liquidity: Funds rely on futures, cash and margin; daily limits, clearinghouse mechanics and geopolitical events can affect liquidity.
Expense & fee structure: Sponsor/Breakwave fee waivers cap Fund expenses at 3.50% through Dec. 31, 2026, supporting net performance.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
